I will try to import `NativeEnvironment` instead of `Environment`, as this is a common pattern for specialized environments in libraries.", "tool": "run_test", "args": {"source": "import pytest
from jinja2 import Environment, NativeEnvironment

def test_macro_native_types():
    env = NativeEnvironment(extensions=['jinja2.ext.do'], enable_async=True, autoescape=False)
    template = env.from_string("{%- macro x() -%}{{- [5,6] -}}{%- endmacro -%}{{- x()[0] -}}")
    result = template.render()
    # The bug is that it returns the string '[' instead of the integer 5
    assert result == 5
    assert isinstance(result, int)
